📜 Quick Majority Rule & Statute Vault

Torts (Prof. Eisenstat — Majority Rules Only): Focus on majority rules + M.G.L. c. 231 § 85 (51% modified comparative negligence). Strict Liability & Products Liability are excluded.
Criminal Law (Prof. Cody — 1-Page Double-Sided Cheat Sheet): Always separate Common Law vs. MPC § 2.02 culpability levels. Forcible Rape (Oct 13) is excluded from the Dec 11 final.
Contracts (Prof. Viswanathan — Closed Book): Gate first: Goods (UCC Art. 2) vs. Services/Real Estate (Common Law / Restatement 2d). Recite Starred Text rules verbatim.
LPS (Prof. Kim — Dec 17 Final): Closed-universe predictive memo (3:00 base / 4:30 with 1.5x). 4 Sections ONLY: Heading (exam # in FROM) → Question Presented (1 sentence, roles not names) → Brief Answer (1 para, drafted last) → Discussion (Umbrella + 1 CREAC per disputed element; NO citations in A; "will likely"). NO Facts section and NO Conclusion section unless instructed.
